text:
ike: quick heads-up — onboarding kyoto-v2 int8 on staging, small locale smoke failures.

meilin: short list?

ike: two reproducible issues on int8 only: (1) japanese keigo prompts lose polite phrasing; (2) arabic/LTR mixed lines sometimes flip parentheses and drop trailing punctuation.

oscar: only with which profile/kernel?

ike: int8 with matmul-v3 + fused-softmax. fp32 and q4 look fine.

tess: any token id diffs or quick repro?

ike: token counts same. trace shows inserted 0 token in mixed-dir contexts. snippet:

```
fp32 ids: [4032, 11, 2710, 88]
int8 ids: [4032, 11, 0, 2710, 88]
```

ike: causes detok+bidi to reorder parens: "(API)" -> ")API(" and sometimes the final `?` is missing.

meilin: sounds like a nul insertion from sampling or a stray zeroed slot in the output buffer. can someone run `scripts/repro_locale.sh --model kyoto-v2 --profile int8-v3` and drop minimal trace?

oscar: running now.

ci-bot: deployment staging-int8-kyoto-2026-03-21-176600 applied

oscar: quick repro attached: generated ids show extra 0 before punctuation. detok -> ")API(". filing ML ticket.

tess: mitigation: add detok sanitizer to collapse NUL/0 tokens before unicode-bidi and add two smoke tests to the onboard suite (ja-keigo-preserve, ar-paren-preserve). block int8 rollouts on failure.

ike: opened ML-2010 with failing examples and metrics (internal). tagging runtime and tokenizer teams.

oscar: i'll run asan+svmap on matmul-v3 to trace pointer/stride issues. ETA ~3h.

tess: i'll add CI smoke cases and a guard PR for detok.

meilin: thanks — keep updates here. :pray:
